design_gaps.title: EV versus non-EV product identity
design_gaps.question: Which measurable composition distinction can discriminate a secretome-retaining-EV product from a small-EV preparation?
design_gaps.rationale: Canonical Manufacturing records exact drug-substance identity and fractionation as unresolved.

design_gaps.title: Source-cell definition
design_gaps.question: Which source-cell attributes should be evaluated for their relationship to a reproducible SGL-001 product signature?
design_gaps.rationale: Canonical Manufacturing records source qualification and cell-bank strategy as evidence gaps.

design_gaps.title: Mechanism-linked potency
design_gaps.question: Which non-clinical functional readout could discriminate a mechanism-linked product signal from particle abundance alone?
design_gaps.rationale: Canonical Manufacturing records potency as an evidence gap and prohibits particle count as established potency.

design_gaps.title: Stability-indicating attributes
design_gaps.question: Which exploratory attributes could reveal loss of product integrity during formulation and storage studies?
design_gaps.rationale: No canonical SGL-001 stability program or verified shelf life exists.

design_gaps.title: Intranasal formulation compatibility
design_gaps.question: How should formulation and device compatibility be tested without assuming preserved EV identity or activity?
design_gaps.rationale: Vehicle, stabilizer, and device compatibility remain unresolved canonical actions.

design_gaps.title: Lot comparability
design_gaps.question: Which exploratory fingerprint could be assessed across future representative lots without becoming a premature release specification?
design_gaps.rationale: Canonical Manufacturing records no lots and lot reproducibility as an evidence gap.
